description:

Wir sind ein werteorientiertes Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, Generationen dabei zu unterstützen, die Wunder der Kindheit zu entdecken und ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Dabei leiten uns folgende Prinzipien:

We collaborate

Bei Mattel suchen wir ständig nach neuen und besseren Wegen, innovative Produkte und Erlebnisse zu schaffen. Egal, in welchem Bereich du arbeitest: Du kannst etwas bewegen und echten Einfluss haben. Neue Ideen und mutige Denkansätze sind bei uns immer willkommen.

Gleichzeitig glauben wir daran, dass Menschen dann ihr Bestes geben, wenn sie Freiraum bekommen, Ideen umzusetzen und Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Wer wir sind

Mattel ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Spielwaren und Familienunterhaltung und besitzt eines der bekanntesten Markenportfolios der Welt. Zu unseren Marken gehören unter anderem Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA und Polly Pocket sowie weitere beliebte Marken und Lizenzpartnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Unternehmen.

Seit 1945 unterstützt Mattel Generationen dabei, die Wunder der Kindheit zu entdecken und ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur wurde bereits von Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME und vielen weiteren ausgezeichnet.

description:
Description

The Global Transportation & Logistics team is seeking a Logistic Specialist to optimize worldwide logistics operations through strong analytical skills, Excel proficiency, and the ability to manage tactical supply chain challenges with limited guidance.

You'll develop business strategies and design workflows to determine optimal transportation selection and routing assignments that meet customer delivery needs, while leveraging your functional knowledge of procurement, transportation, and warehouse operations to analyze trends, identify cost savings, and maintain process documentation including SOPs and workflow trackers. Working at the workflow and process level, you'll partner with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, execute change management, drive operational excellence, and meet key operational metrics (SLAs, productivity, quality benchmarks) while managing risks, escalating roadblocks, and collaborating with Analytics and Tech teams to enhance data reporting across our data center logistics network.

Key job responsibilities


 * Monitor global supply chain trends, support cross-functional strategies, and identify, achieve, and report on savings targets
 * Own and maintain workflow processes, trackers, documentation, SOPs, process flows, and FAQs
 * Execute change management for process updates and compliance
 * Troubleshoot issues independently and partner with teams to solve problems through the identification of root causes to minimize defects and future problems

 * Track, escalate, and resolve risks and roadblocks appropriately
 * Apply analytical and statistical skills with advanced Excel (V-lookups, Pivot Tables) to extract and analyze trend data
 * Work backward from customer requirements to ensure optimal solutions

A typical day as a Logistic Specialist involve collaborating with internal stakeholders across Janus Operations, Quality, Operations, Systems Engineering, and Program Management teams to ensure seamless spare part delivery for AWS IPS, DCO, and ACL customers. You'll start your morning analyzing transportation data and tracking metrics to identify potential delays or quality issues, then work with cross-functional partners to troubleshoot routing challenges and optimize delivery schedules. You'll participate in strategic planning sessions to identify cost savings opportunities, execute change management initiatives to improve compliance, and escalate critical risks that could impact on-time delivery. Your primary focus is solving the complex challenge of ensuring spare parts arrive on-time and in perfect condition to support worldwide data center operations—balancing trade-offs between speed, cost, and quality while meeting SLA commitments and maintaining operational excellence across the global logistics network.

The Global Transportation & Logistics (GTL) team is the backbone of worldwide supply chain operations, united by a clear mission: to deliver what our customers need, where they need it, when they need it. We operate at the intersection of strategy and execution in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where analytical rigor meets operational excellence, and every decision impacts the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting our data center operations. Our culture is customer-obsessed and data-driven—we work backward from customer needs, partner across functions with teams like Janus Operations, Quality, Systems Engineering, and Program Management, and take ownership of complex logistics challenges that span continents. We value problem-solvers who can dive deep into data, troubleshoot independently, and drive continuous improvement through process enhancements and scalable solutions. GTL is committed to developing our people—we empower team members to grow their skills, take on new challenges, and advance their careers while making a tangible impact on global operations. If you're passionate about supply chain optimization and want to grow in an environment where your contributions directly enable customer success, GTL offers the support, mentorship, and opportunities to help you thrive.

 * Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
 * Experience in process design and documentation

 * Experience in Excel with advanced proficiency (pivots, lookups, etc.)
 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field

 * Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot issues independently

Your research will include mapping battery technology trends and cost drivers, assessing production capacities and job potential, and evaluating import dependencies and trade partnerships. Programmgestaltung

 * Regulatory Support: Begleite Zulassungsverfahren für Arzneimittel und Nahrungsergänzungsmittel. In enger Abstimmung mit den Fachabteilungen stellst du sicher, dass regulatorische Fristen und Anforderungen präzise erfüllt werden
   
   

Qualität & Compliance


 * Regulatory Compliance: Trage aktiv zur Einhaltung nationaler und internationaler Richtlinien bei. Damit bildest du das Rückgrat für Qualitätsstandards, die jeder behördlichen Prüfung standhalten
 * Pharmacovigilance: Unterstütze die Arzneimittelsicherheit bei der Erfassung und Evaluierung sicherheitsrelevanter Daten – denn Patientensicherheit hat für uns oberste Priorität
   
   

Prozessoptimierung

 * Entwicklungswille: Du bringst den aufrichtigen Wunsch mit, dich kontinuierlich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – und nach dem Traineeprogramm als vollwertiges Mitglied eines starken, interdisziplinären Teams richtig durchzustarten

Your profile


 * A bright and curious mind: Strong academic background and the desire to dive deep into a highly complex business model with conceptual, commercial, agricultural, technological, regulatory and operational challenges - and the prospect of generating massive impact by improving soil health at scale
 * Strategic thinker with strong execution skills: 4-8 years of operational or project management experience, able to combine commercial/strategic judgment with a bias for hands-on execution and follow-through.

Your benefits:

 * Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

title: Director of Trading & Procurement
description:
About The Company

The AI-driven trade platform transforming industrial supply in infrastructure, energy, and construction materials. It connects vetted suppliers across Asia, Europe, and the GCC region with local demand through a single integrated platform.

Its proprietary AI stack digitizes and automates the full lifecycle of materials trade – from procurement and pricing to inventory, logistics, and embedded financing – replacing thousands of manual, relationship-driven processes with real-time orchestration.

Buyers gain instant quotes, reliable availability, and predictable delivery through a unified operating system. Suppliers benefit from accurate forecasting, disciplined demand management, and seamless integration into cross-border fulfillment networks. The company partners with leading brands to run both dropship and cross-dock fulfillment motions for large-scale transactions, turning global supply chains into predictable, repeatable, software-like workflows.

The company has scaled to triple-digit-million GMV, operates across six international markets, and is rapidly expanding toward profitability. With a team of 80+ people across Berlin (HQ) and Asia, it is building the world’s first industrial-grade AI operating system for materials – redefining how global trade works in one of the world’s largest and most essential industries.

The company is backed by top-tier investors as well as global institutional banking partners, having recently closed its $40m series B - Atomico, Project A, and Invent Capital with institutional backing from Commerzbank and KfW.

The Role

This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading: fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly.

You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space.

You report directly to the SVP Operations and sit on the operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement.

What You Will Do


 * Build and run the procurement machine: Develop and execute procurement strategies that support a high 2-digit monthly procurement spend with exponential growth. Negotiate favourable terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers on a daily basis.
 * Lead and develop the team: Manage 10+ team members, set clear priorities daily, coach emerging team leads, and create a culture of accountability and speed. You will need to be assertive and hands-on.
 * Create scalable processes: Design, implement, and continuously improve procurement workflows, playbooks, and controls. Processes are implemented in days and weeks at Andercore — not quarters and years.
 * Own supplier relationships: Source, evaluate, and onboard suppliers. Maintain and expand a high-quality supplier network with strong retention across existing and emerging markets.
 * Drive margin improvement: Identify cost-saving opportunities, optimise purchasing decisions, and improve payment terms to boost net revenue margin and cash cycle.
 * Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Accounting, and Product & Engineering to align supply with demand and ensure operational excellence.
 * Leverage data and AI: Use data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor supplier performance, and identify market trends. Embrace AI tools to automate and scale procurement operations.
   
   

What Success Looks Like


 * Supplier revenue targets consistently met or exceeded through high availability and competitive pricing.
 * A robust, high-quality supplier network with strong retention and engagement across existing and emerging markets.
 * Streamlined, repeatable processes that reduce time-to-onboard, minimise errors, and allow the team to scale without linear headcount growth.
 * A high-performing, motivated team with emerging team leads and strong cross-functional collaboration.
 * Accurate, data-driven reporting that drives continuous improvement and informs executive strategy.
 * Run a category management that unlocks and owns new product lines
   
   

Who You Are

Must-Haves


 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top university or business school.
 * 2–5 years in a high-performance environment: Tier-1 strategy consulting (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or commodity trading / high-velocity B2B procurement.
 * Proven ability to build processes and delegate effectively. You must be able to create systems that outlast your personal involvement — not do everything yourself.
 * Strong assertiveness and people leadership. You will manage a young team that needs clear direction, daily prioritisation, and coaching.
 * Ability to operate at both strategic and granular levels: setting category strategy in the morning and reviewing individual POs in the afternoon.
 * Excellent analytical and communication skills. Fluent English is required; German is a strong plus.
 * Comfortable with a high-intensity, fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift daily.
 * Hard-working, proactive, and independent. Willing to go the extra mile to get the job done.
   
   

Nice-to-Haves


 * Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, or construction / infrastructure / energy materials.
 * Exposure to AI-driven operations or automation of procurement workflows.
 * Familiarity with cross-border trade and international supplier management.
   
   

This Role Is Not For You If…


 * Your procurement experience is in slow-cycle, enterprise purchasing (annual contracts, quarterly reviews). Our cadence is daily.
 * You are strong on analysis but weak on implementation. We need someone who executes, not just diagnoses.
 * You prefer to do things yourself rather than build teams and processes. Delegation and system-building are non-negotiable.
 * You need a fully structured environment to be effective. Here, you will create the structure.
   
   

What We Offer


 * A critical leadership role with direct impact on company growth and P&L.
 * Highly competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
 * A smart, ambitious team backed by top-tier investors — building something that doesn’t exist yet.
 * Berlin headquarters with a global, multicultural operating environment.
   
   

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.
